camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList --region cn-hangzhou --AccessInstanceType AckClusterConnector --AccessInstanceStatus created
description_en: Queries the list of regions for sync nodes
description_zh: 查询同步节点地域列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-access-instance-region-list --access-instance-status created --access-instance-type AckClusterConnector --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList

parameters.help_en:
The sync node status. Used to filter by status.

Currently, only the "created" status is supported for filtering. Passing other values (such as "ready") causes the request to fail
parameters.help_zh:
同步节点状态。用于按状态筛选。

当前仅支持 "created" 状态筛选，传入其他值（如 "ready"）将导致请求失败
parameters.name: access_instance_status

parameters.help_en:
The sync node type. Valid values:

PrivateDns: Private DNS (default value if not specified).

AckClusterConnector: ACK cluster connector
parameters.help_zh:
同步节点类型。取值：

PrivateDns：私有DNS（不传时默认为PrivateDns）。

AckClusterConnector：ACK集群连接器
parameters.name: access_instance_type
